rows.jyutping: hou2 m4 jung4 ji6 sin1 V
rows.note: Use this pattern when the action takes effort, including finally managing to do something or say something despite difficulty.

example.english: I manage to say this sentence only with great difficulty.
example.traditional: 我好唔容易先講得出呢句說話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 m4 jung4 ji6 sin1 gong2 dak1 ceot1 ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for handling or dealing with a situation, problem, or job.

example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 tau4 sou3 ngo5 wui5 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when saying that you can cope or get something done without help.

example.english: I can manage this report by myself.
example.traditional: 呢份報告我自己搞得掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6

rows.note: Use this when managing people, a team, an organization, or other responsibilities under your direction.

example.jyutping: ngo5 fu6 zaak3 gun2 lei5 sing4 go3 tyun4 deoi6
